comment: Eric and Eli are in a league of their own. Gifted speakers who eloquently educate participants on using individual strengths to become better, confident speakers. Chapeau!

Highly recommend this course for anyone looking to improve on their public speaking skills. Such fantastic and tangible tips that will definitely help me in future presentations. Eric and Eli are also incredibly dynamic, so the course was extremely memorable and will be easy to recall in the future. It left me feeling inspired and confident - 12/10 experience!

Truly fantastic and transformative program. You really learn to improve and hone your public speaking skills. Eli and Eric take you through many different workshops of choosing your projector that make you an effective and engaging speaker. Highly highly recommend!!
Life changing experience! Never thought I would grow and learn so much about public speaking in a few short hours!!
Great Experience, breaking down what makes a great speaker. Would recommend taking this course.
Best workshop I've been too. Learned so much about human interactions, and how to  express my ideas in a way that will be heard, felt and remembered. Thank you Eli and Eric!

I left the session feeling much clearer on structuring a speech, engaging the audience and conveying my message with confidence. I also know what type of practice and skills I need to hone in on to improve. Eric’s methods were practical and he was incredibly engaging. —I highly recommend!

The Speaker Lab training stands out as one of the most impactful trainings I’ve ever attended. It offered clear, actionable strategies and practical tools that I can immediately apply to improve my presentations. I appreciated that it wasn’t just a lecture, we were able to actively practice presenting, receive feedback, and refine our approach. Thanks E&E!!!

The 5-day training from Speaker Labs at the Global Speakers Academy was beyond transformational—it was exceptional.

What stood out most was the thoughtful structure and delivery of the entire experience. Every element, from how each day was sequenced to how feedback was delivered, was purposeful and masterfully executed. You could feel the precision behind the process. It wasn’t just about public speaking, it was about clarity, confidence, and connection.

Eli and Eric’s preparation was truly next-level. On Day 1, they already knew all 40 of us—our names, stories, and talk topics. You walk in a stranger, and they greet you like they’ve known you for years. That level of presence and intentionality created a safe, powerful space for growth.

If you’re serious about improving your speaking capabilies  message, your impact, and your growth as a speaker, Speaker Labs is the gold standard.

High energy backed up by high value content.  I learned a lot of good strategies to  and had improv class levels of fun participating.  Excellent 2 day speaking course I'd recommend to anyone interested in better speaking or storytelling.
Very good 😊

Eli and Eric are absolutely amazing people, facilitators, and coaches. The lessons we’ll be able to apply to many other components of our lives.
Highly recommend!

Had the chance to work with Speaker Lab for the Global Speaker Academy. They are amazing!! Learned a lot, but more importantly, because they are so good at communicating, I remember what I learned.thank guys!

I just finished an incredible weekend learning how to become a better public speaker! Speaker Labs put on a week-long event that I attended that was one of the most transformational learning experiences I've ever had. I still use their method when preparing for all of my talks, and they delivered an incredible blend of learning, engagement, and experience to people wanting to grow as speakers. I cannot recommend them highly enough!!

I recently completed the public speaking course at Speaker Labs, and I can confidently say it was a game-changer. Eli and Eric, the co-owners, brought a wealth of knowledge and passion to every lesson. The course content was comprehensive, covering everything from speech structure to body language and vocal delivery. The Protector vs. Projector mindset concept was my personal game-changer. This powerful idea completely transformed how I approach public speaking, making me feel more in control. The practical exercises and real-life examples made the material engaging and easy to grasp. By the end of the course, I felt more confident and prepared to deliver impactful speeches.
I wish I would have been given this knowledge at the beginning of my career.

This was the single best investment of my time to level up my public speaking skills and confidence, literally overnight!  Eli and Eric are engaging, creative, innovative and impactful.  They will transform how you approach content, delivery, visuals and perhaps most importantly your mindset.  You already have it in you, they have unlocked a way to bring it out in everyone in their class, really everyone.  It was amazing to witness these learnings in only 2 amazing days.  Thank you for the valuable lessons, stories and time.

Speaker Labs is absolutely world class. I had the pleasure of participating in a 2-day program with Eric & Eli and they rocked it. Not only was it entertaining, funny and enjoyable, the learning & practice was TRANSFORMATIVE for the group. Bravo! Highest recommendation possible.

I've completed Speakers Labs training multiple times, and worked with them one-on-one to develop keynotes, and I can easily say they are the most engaging and talented communications trainers I've ever worked with (and the best professional development training I've ever been a part of in my career). They are engaging, funny, and excellent at getting across their key points on how to develop compelling presentations; but more importantly they address how to get over the fear and anxiety of public speaking, and they give all participants a safe space to put their curriculum into practice. After completing our most recent training with the Willful team in December, our team feels more empowered to flex their public speaking muscle, and we feel closer as a team. Thank you Eric and Eli for doing what you do!

After participating in a 2-day online workshop, all I have to say is that I had an amazing experience! This is the type of content that is good for anyone in any area. Thank you for bringing forth the projector in us all, Eli and Eric. Keep up with your great work!
Insanely eye-opening. I felt so much more comfortable presenting coming out of our workshop than I did going in. Eric and Eli are fantastic at what they do and how they teach public speaking!
